title: Form 1099-DIV box 4 statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 4 of a Form 1099-DIV furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1099-DIV box 4 only: it says nothing about boxes 1a, 2a, 7, or 12. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
